inference.purpose: bundled Whisper speech recognition and installed system voices

oauth.purpose: Google OAuth code exchange and refresh for the configured installed client
oauth.data: OAuth credentials; no calendar/email content or AI prompts
oauth.allowed: previously connected account or user-initiated sign-in

connected_services: Google Calendar, Gmail and Drive sync directly to the device
Slack and other explicitly connected services
zero_retention_routes: Groq with key-bound owner confirmation; no hosted-tool models

inference: provider selected by the user in Settings

notes: Privacy Mode does not infer a provider's contractual Zero Data Retention status from an API key.
On-device mode blocks cloud inference. Zero-retention mode permits only explicitly qualified routes; connected online services remain available in both modes.
Privacy pilot evidence is stored locally and leaves the computer only when a user explicitly copies and shares it.
User-directed browser navigation is intentionally outside this manifest; it requires an explicit user request.

account_state_backup.purpose: Restore authoritative GBrain state on a replacement device
account_state_backup.data: Client-side encrypted Markdown and versioned Loops, follow-through and goals records; opaque metadata; authenticated account identity
account_state_backup.allowed: Separate explicit account-and-device-scoped opt-in in both Privacy Mode settings; no automatic opt-in on sign-in
account_state_backup.key_custody: Account recovery: random data key wrapped by managed KMS and bound to immutable Knapsack account/key version; native-only recovery after verified recent Google/Microsoft authentication; optional OS credential store for automatic backups; Knapsack authorized service can recover/decrypt contents
account_state_backup.retention: Latest three encrypted snapshots; disabling backup stops uploads but retains snapshots
account_state_backup.exclusions: Credential stores, tokens, databases, runtime configuration and executable files
account_state_backup.rollout_gate: Disabled until managed KMS, immutable provider account identity and genuine recent-auth integrations are configured and verified; no password/token/email key derivation or plaintext fallback
